terra.problem: The invitation is to all the king's sons, not the whole royal family.
The invitation names the king and his servants, not the whole household. The claim that Absalom is not trying to keep the crowd small also assigns him an unstated intention.
Amnon being David's oldest son is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The wine is the condition they are told to watch for. Absalom's order to strike is the signal to kill Amnon.
The text does not say how fast their getaway was or that no one stayed to find out what happened next.
The report says David's sons have been killed, not that he has lost everything. The text does not state that he thinks he has lost everything.
Jonadab says when Absalom began planning, but he does not explicitly give Absalom's reason for the killing.
The passage does not say the arriving men are not coming for anyone.
